_comment: Single source of truth for server settings, shared with apply-config.sh. Entries with `env` are panel variables applied at boot; all entries are readable/writable via admin-http GET/PUT /api/settings. `file` is a logical sink (UserEngine|UserGame|ondemand). v3 (2026-06-02): added the verified UClass-config catalogue. The UClass mechanism IS real ([/Script/...] overrides applied on server RESTART) — v2's blanket 'those names don't exist' was an over-correction; only specific hexaspark names (e.g. GlobalXPMultiplier) were fiction. The API-managed UClass knobs sink to UserOverrides (state/UserOverrides.ini), which prestart.sh strips + re-appends into UserGame.ini verbatim on every boot (the egg's designed override channel; takes precedence). The 8 env/panel UClass entries stay in UserGame (apply-config writes them from panel vars at boot). Every UClass key here is sourced from Funcom's DuneSandbox/Config/DefaultGame.ini AND byte-verified present in DuneSandboxServer-Linux-Shipping. `advanced`=struct/array (panel renders a raw-text field; multi-line arrays carry an empty default — set verbatim from DefaultGame.ini). `client_gated`=yes means clients clamp to default unless they also edit their own Game.ini. New UClass entries are verified:false until live-tested in-game (apply on RESTART only).
